artworks.title: Lady Elizabeth Compton
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing and leaning against a low wall outdoors. She has an elaborate hairstyle with large curls and wears a flowing gown with a pendant necklace. The background includes lush trees, foliage, and a pathway leading into the distance.

artworks.title: "Expected--alarming rise in the price of soap!"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with pink, blue, brown, and green wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an illustration showing a humorous note on rising soap prices. The image features a cartoon-style illustration of two hands pulling on a face with exaggerated features. There is handwritten text above the illustration that reads "Expected Alarming Rise in the Price of Soap!!!" The rest of the page contains a note written in cursive, discussing the implications of rising soap prices and suggesting purchasing soap before the price increase. The overall tone of the image is satirical, possibly mocking commercial or economic concerns in a lighthearted manner.

artworks.title: George Cruikshank (decorative signature)
artworks.medium: pen and ink over graphite on blue paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 20 x 32.2 cm (7 7/8 x 12 11/16 in.)
support: 30.5 x 40.7 cm (12 x 16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of elaborate and stylized handwriting. The work features expressive and decorative script written in dark ink on a light background. The strokes are fluid and bold, with varying thickness creating visual contrast. The handwriting is embellished with loops and swirls, emphasizing aesthetic form over readability. The paper appears slightly discolored and aged, adding character to the piece.

artworks.title: Street Perspective with Places of Business Labeled
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite annotations on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 14.3 x 22.9 cm (5 5/8 x 9 in.)
support: 40.7 x 30.5 cm (16 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with buildings on both sides of the road. A lamp post is on the left. The road stretches into the distance with vanishing point perspective. The drawing style is detailed with fine lines outlining the buildings and text. The color scheme is mostly black and white. Various business names and notes are written throughout the drawing.

artworks.title: Sketch of Octagon Recess with Columns
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 33.5 x 21 cm (13 3/16 x 8 1/4 in.)
support: 40.7 x 30.5 cm (16 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design. The drawing depicts an arched structural design supported by two columns with detailed notes written around various parts of the drawing. The arch features intricate decorations, including ornamental elements, and appears to have a flame-like design at the apex. The columns are shown with textured bases, and various annotations provide insights into the materials or structural specifications, like indicating places for gilt or instructions for construction such as measurements or materials. The overall style suggests a study or plan for a piece of decorative architecture with a focus on both aesthetic and practical elements.

artworks.title: Sketches of Grotesque Faces
artworks.medium: graphite with pink, blue, and brown wash on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 21.2 x 19.1 cm (8 3/8 x 7 1/2 in.)
support: 40.7 x 30.5 cm (16 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of various sketches and notes on a sheet of paper. The sketches include a hand, facial profiles, and architectural elements, along with handwritten cursive notes. Some of the sketches are lightly colored, especially around the hair of the faces. One face in the top right has long hair and a beard, looking upwards. There are annotations next to each drawing, possibly indicating names like "Sir Cecil Trafford" and "Cardinal Allen." The center of the paper shows what appears to be an architectural column or detail with accompanying text. In the bottom left corner, there are two overlapping faces with a startled expression. The overall composition suggests a page of studies or notes for a project related to architecture or history.

artworks.title: Sketch of Mounted Hussar
artworks.medium: pen and ink with red, blue, and brown wash on two overlapped, joined sheets from a letter
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 12.6 cm (4 15/16 in.)
support: 40.7 x 30.5 cm (16 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This painting features a handwritten note beside a sketch of a horse and rider in armor. The text includes phrases like "awful ignorance of Divine powers" and "the dark ages." The handwriting is cursive and challenging to read. In the bottom right corner, there is a quick and fluid sketch of a rider on a horse, capturing movement with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Half-Length of a Lawyer and Other Sketches
artworks.medium: graphite and pen and brown ink with pink, brown, and blue wash
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 20.5 x 18.6 cm (8 1/16 x 7 5/16 in.)
support: 40.7 x 30.5 cm (16 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a small caricature of a person gesturing with their hand. The drawing includes roughly sketched figures and cursive handwriting throughout the sheet. One figure is in the lower right corner with exaggerated features, pointing with an outstretched arm. Another small figure is at the top of the paper. Handwritten notes are scattered with varied legibility and style, giving the impression of an artist's sketch or notation page. The setup suggests a playful and informal study, potentially for a larger work or idea in development.

artworks.title: Satirical Sketches
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 23.1 x 19 cm (9 1/8 x 7 1/2 in.)
support: 40.7 x 30.5 cm (16 x 12 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This is a drawing containing various doodles and caricatures. The page shows sketched figures and objects in ink. In the upper left, there is a caricature of a profile of a person's head. To the right, a devilish figure with horns is depicted holding a drinking vessel. Below, there is a figure holding scales in one hand and a bottle in the other. In the center, there is an angry or serious-faced figure. Below, there is a smaller figure next to a cylindrical object. Handwritten text reads "Beware of Polly-ticks" and "George Cruikshank his Book". A candle burning on a holder is drawn at the bottom of the page.

artworks.title: Sketches of Head, Arm, and Kneeling Figure
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and black ink, with pink, brown,  and green wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Clements C. Fry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure accompanied by handwritten notes. The image features a caricature of a man wearing a top hat and includes a playful sketch of a crouched figure. The page is filled with handwritten text, lists, and calculations, along with a few doodles. The drawing has a light and whimsical tone, with fluid and cartoonish style strokes.

artworks.title: The Poet Virgil Suspended in a Basket
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in an intricate scene. In the foreground, there is a seated woman wearing a detailed gown, along with an elderly man with a cane engaged in conversation. Surrounding them are several men in old-world attire. Two children are depicted to the left, next to a rock inscribed with the year "1525." In the background, there is a street scene with smaller figures, leading to a distant stone structure and trees, indicating depth. The architecture suggests a historical or classical setting.

artworks.title: Female Genius Holding a Coat of Arms
artworks.description: The image shows a young, cherubic figure with wings. The figure is standing with one foot on the ground and the other leg resting on a large sphere. The figure has curly hair and chubby facial features. The cherub is depicted nude with a decorative fabric wrapped around one leg, holding a heraldic shield in its right hand and an elaborate helmet in its left. The background is plain. The monogram "ISB" and the date "1535" are inscribed on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Male Genius Holding a Coat of Arms
artworks.description: The image shows a winged child holding a shield and helmet. The figure has detailed wings and stands barefoot, looking to the left. In one hand, they hold a helmet and in the other a shield. At the feet of the figure, there is a ball. The drawing emphasizes classical features using line work and shading for depth.

artworks.title: The Descent of the Angels to One of the Daughters of Men
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three human-like figures. The central figure is nude with flowing hair and is posed with one arm reaching upwards. On either side of the central figure are two other humanoid forms depicted in a semi-transparent manner. Radiating lines extend from the side figures. The composition features soft, curving lines and blends gently into the background.

artworks.title: An Angel Teaching a Daughter of Men the Secrets of Sin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract scene with figures and flowing forms. The drawing features a central figure in a flowing environment. The lines are fluid and suggest movement, with surrounding elements that could be interpreted as organic shapes or otherworldly figures. The drawing is light and sketchy, creating a sense of delicacy. A sense of depth and volume is given through the combination of light and heavy strokes. The abstract and suggestive nature of the drawing encourages viewers to engage with their imagination.

artworks.title: The Daughter of Men Becomes a Siren
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch featuring multiple human figures. The sketch shows full-length body depictions of two standing figures and one figure lying down. The standing figures are drawn with arms raised, one on the left and one centrally placed. The left figure appears as if floating or in motion, with markings on the body, potentially scales or texture, and has a curly hairstyle. The central standing figure has a slight tilt suggesting movement or dance. The facial features are not detailed but imply an upward gaze. Both figures appear unclothed, their forms suggested with light lines. The lying figure is depicted in a reclined position. The background is plain and unmarked, emphasizing the sketched figures without distraction. No jewelry or objects are distinguished in the drawing. The artwork has a rough, ethereal quality typical of a preliminary sketch.

artworks.title: Enoch before the Great Glory
artworks.description: The image features softly drawn geometric shapes and flowing lines forming an abstract composition. There are circles and curved lines, with a central figure surrounded by three smaller humanoid figures. The arrangement could be interpreted as a central figure seated on a throne, attended by the smaller figures around it. The shapes suggest faces and drapery, contributing to the ghostly and mystical appearance, blending with the abstract nature of the drawing.

artworks.title: The Vision of the Lord of Spirits
artworks.description: The sketch depicts several figures in various poses. The central figure is standing upright, flanked by other figures. The central figure's facial features are softly outlined with a focus on the eyes, and there are wavy indications of hair. The clothing is not explicitly detailed, giving the impression of a nude form with sketchy lines suggesting motion or drapery. There are no visible jewelry or objects. Surrounding the central figure are other human forms in different poses. The background has light pencil markings, and handwritten notes are present at the top and bottom of the sketch.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Attributed to Lucas Emil Vorsterman
artworks.description: The image shows three figures from the waist up. The central figure is seated with shoulders exposed, head slightly tilted and downward, wearing a crown of thorns, with light radiating behind their head. He has curly hair and a beard, with a somber facial expression. The figure on the left is looking up at the central figure, with curly hair and facial hair, wearing layered garments and a cloak. A third figure is slightly behind them, wearing a helmet. Both figures on the left hold wooden staffs. The background is dark, and there's Latin text along the bottom edge of the image.

artworks.title: Titian and His Mistress
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Attributed to Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Titian
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring an elderly man and a woman. The man is on the left, touching the woman's shoulder. He has a long beard, a cap, and wrinkles. The woman has wavy hair, wearing a dress with a fur collar. The background is dark with a human skull placed on a shelf in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Peasant Filling a Glass
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing and pouring liquid from a jug into a glass. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, red shirt, green vest, yellow pants tucked into purple hose, and brown shoes.

artworks.title: Peasant Smoking
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a wooden bench. The person is leaning forward and their facial features include a nose and a beard. They are wearing a red cap under a large black hat, a brown vest over a purple shirt, a brown belt, yellowish pants, and holding a long-stemmed pipe. Beside them on the bench is a tanned jug. The background is plain and light-colored.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with Orpheus and the Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collection of classical figures and mythological motifs. It features detailed scenes and decorative elements including medallions of mythological activities, scrollwork, intertwined figures, winged beings, and classical deities engaged in various actions. The drawing is rich in classical iconography and arranged in a harmonious and orderly manner reminiscent of Renaissance artwork.

artworks.title: Sibylla Persica
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with relaxed posture, wearing classic garments, holding a book. They have curly hair with a decorative band, looking serene. Background displays clouds and rays of light.
